decisions.reason: This custom earmold fits the firm's core hearing-care competence and digital production, so keeping it costs little while its uncertain prospects are still resolving, although the bare website mention signals weaker commitment than its siblings.
The EARsleeve has its own dedicated page and an explicit launch statement, and it uses existing earmold manufacturing at low marginal cost, so this option is clearly worth holding open.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is a mainstream dental-lab device that sits within the firm's established equipment line and has a page of its own, and the evidence so far gives no reason to abandon it before the market has revealed its value.
